definition: Manages a portfolio of customer accounts and renews their contracts.
Sells products to new customers and closes deals.
Maintains sales forecasts, territories and pipeline reports.
Explains the technical side of products during a sale and runs demonstrations.
Finds and qualifies new sales leads by outreach.
Helps existing customers adopt products and stay satisfied after the sale.
Generic role for the Sales family.
Builds budgets, forecasts and variance reports.
Keeps the general ledger and prepares monthly accounts.
Runs payroll and resolves pay queries.
Tests financial controls and reports findings to the audit committee.
Manages cash positions, bank accounts and short-term funding.
Generic role for the Finance family.
